# unifi_vpn_server (Data Source)

Retrieves a VPN server via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). VPN servers are read-only on the Official API. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_vpn_server" "office" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the VPN server to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VPN server is enabled.
- `json` (String) The full VPN server overview, including type-specific fields, serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the VPN server entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`, `DERIVED`).
- `name` (String) The name of the VPN server.
- `type` (String) The VPN server type (e.g. `WIREGUARD_SERVER`, `OPENVPN_SERVER`, `L2TP_SERVER`, `PPTP_SERVER`).
